subject: general
question: Two cyclists start toward each other from towns A and B, which are 150 { km} apart. Cyclist A leaves A at 6:00 a.m. with a speed of 20 { km/h} . Cyclist B leaves B at 7:00 a.m. and they meet at 9:00 a.m. Find the speed of cyclist B (in {km/h} ), rounded to two decimals.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Distance covered by A (6:00 am to 9:00 am) = 20 × 3 = 60 km.

Remaining distance covered by B = 150 − 60 = 90 km.

Time duration for cyclist B (7:00 am to 9:00 am) = 2 hours.

Speed of B = Distance ÷ Time = 90 ÷ 2 = 45 km/h.

**∴ The correct answer is 45.00 km/h.**
